title: Cheapest Way to Get a Professional AI Commercial Made in 2026
summary: The cheapest way to get a professional AI commercial made, compared by route: self-serve plans, batch prices and crewed shoots, as of October 2026.
body_markdown:
The cheapest route is a self-serve AI video plan from $15 a month, but that plan leaves the script, scenes, voice, edit and review to you, and those steps are what make a commercial look professional. For a finished, person-checked commercial, Knowlify is our done-for-you pick, from $5,000 a month, well above a self-serve plan. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What makes an AI commercial cost more than a clip


[Runway](https://runway.com/resources/ai-generated-commercials) , which sells AI video tools, describes an AI commercial as an ad where AI models produce the footage, voice or edit that a camera crew would otherwise make. That definition explains the price range. A 15-second talking clip needs one script and one presenter. A 60-second spot needs several scenes, a voice, a cut for each placement and at least one review round after every change.


Length, scene count, presenter type, voice and revision rounds drive the price. Turnaround matters too.[351 Studio's AI video production page](https://351studio.com/ai-video-production) describes generative AI with human creative direction, editors and VFX artists, and its[social video ads page](https://351studio.com/social-media-video-ads-production) lists typically two revision rounds and a 2 to 12 business day turnaround depending on scope.


## Self-serve plans have the lowest sticker price


The lowest published prices belong to self-serve tools.[Creatify's pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) lists Standard at $15 a month billed monthly ($12 billed annually), with 55 credits that cover 11 fifteen-second avatar videos at 720p or 1K, about $1.36 a video.[HeyGen's pricing page](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) lists Creator at $29 a month ($24 billed annually) with 600 credits, where an Avatar IV video uses 31 credits a minute, about $1.50 per minute of Avatar IV video.


Those are per-clip prices, not per-commercial prices. Higgsfield's Marketing Studio offers a TV Spot mode, but[Higgsfield's pricing page](https://higgsfield.ai/pricing) did not show plan amounts when we checked. Its[Marketing Studio help article](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/tools/how-do-i-use-marketing-studio-to-create-video-ads) says that to change a video you generate it again, and that UGC voiceover and pacing can vary, so you should review each output.


The hidden cost is rework. Each generation spends credits, and a clip that needs a new hook, a re-cut and a caption fix can take several takes before it is usable. Your editing and review hours appear on no plan page. At the managed end,[Creatify's Studio page](https://creatify.ai/studio) puts Studio at $100 to $200 per video in its comparison table, and its pricing page gives no Studio price.


## Knowlify: our done-for-you pick from $5,000 a month


Knowlify is the best fit once you can spend $5,000 a month and want a professional AI commercial without paying for rework, because you receive finished, checked ads instead of credits and editing hours. Knowlify (YC S25) makes AI commercials, meaning live-action-style AI video, alongside AI UGC ads and 3D and character animation. We produce about 25 finished ads a week for Facebook and Instagram, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. You can have us run the Meta campaigns end to end, or take creative only if you already have a media buyer.


Price risk is covered too: if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the site, at[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Our plans start at $5,000 a month, so we do not claim the lowest sticker price. A quote depends on the length, the number of versions, the presenter type and the approval steps, so bring those to a[call](https://knowlify.com/book) . Our[video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) page covers the formats. When to pick another option: a self-serve plan costs less for one short test clip you will edit yourself, and a crewed shoot fits when a real person must appear on camera.


## What the other done-for-you options sell


Published batch prices only mean something when you read the unit.[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) sells AI UGC batches, finished with human editing and quality review: €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, €16,000 for 40 of up to 30 seconds, and €29,000 for 80 of up to 60 seconds.[AI Vidia](https://ai-vidia.com/pricing) , a Copenhagen studio, lists a Pilot Sprint at €4,900 for 18 finished videos by day 14, and a Brand System at €18,000 a month for 90 videos up to 60 seconds, excluding media spend.[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) sells 60 videos for $3,495 a month, built from 20 concepts with three hooks each.[Airpost](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) starts at $6,000 a month for a platform plus a dedicated AI video team.[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) is the lowest-priced creative subscription in our October 2026 comparison of subscription services: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20.

Compare cost per approved commercial at the same length. A 60-second spot and a 15-second avatar clip are different products, and a fixed batch count hides how many versions you will need. Crewed production is the reference point:[Start Motion Media](https://www.startmotionmedia.com/commercial-cost) lists typical costs of $8,000 to $10,000 for its process, with a wider US range of $6,000 to $25,000 per advertisement.
